headline: Treasury sanctions Panama/Greece law firm Karnakis & Karnakis, shippers, 9 vessels
dek: Treasury sanctioned Panama- and Greece-based law firm Karnakis and Karnakis (5 associated individuals), Singapore-based Amigoz, UAE-based Whales Shipping Line, Roxette Maritime, and 9 vessels for supporting Iran's 'shadow fleet' — concealing ownership of tankers moving Iranian oil/LPG/steel worth…
sources: US Department of the Treasury press release SB0664 (Oct 21, 2026); FinCEN release; Reuters
fault_line: Sanctions on lawyers and banks — law enforcement against sanctions evasion, or economic war hitting the facilitators?
